# BLO-48145 — 30 s per-test timeout for the vendored suite

Tracking: [BLO-48145](https://paperclip.blockcast.net/BLO/issues/BLO-48145)

Test-config only. `vitest.config.ts` now sets `test.testTimeout: 30_000`.
Many cases (env-guard, prompt-cache, runtime-pin) spawn real node processes, so
their wall time follows runner load rather than the code under test. Under CI
load vitest's 5 s default timed out cases in all three files on PRs that do not
touch this tree, ejecting merge-queue entries (paperclip#2881 at 04:17Z,
paperclip#2875 at 04:56Z on 2026-10-21). Reproduced locally at 2×nproc
busy-loops: 30 spawn tests in env-guard.test.ts alone failed.

No assertion changed. In async code a genuine hang still fails, at 30 s (every
network call the env guard makes is capped at 10 s by `AbortSignal.timeout`).
A hung `spawnSync` child blocks the event loop, so no vitest timeout could
interrupt it, before or after this change.
No vendored source under `src/` changed.
